[描述: a grand palace corridor of the Central Plains seen as memory-space at dusk. Light event: the setting sun filtered through the far arch falls as one long feathered shaft of gold down the length of the corridor floor. Core landmark: a row of tall vermilion columns carrying a double-eave roof, the nearest column close to camera and cropped out of frame. Ground: broad grey brick slabs with washed-away joints. Around: closed lattice doors studded with bronze bosses, brass cranes on pedestals, a flight of stone steps. Fixed: a pair of bronze door knockers cast as beast faces and a lacquered screen set back against the wall. Distance: the deep shadowed inner gate and a drift of yellow dust. Scale anchor: a single guard standing at the far arch at man height.]
